case.title: Review of AI-Generated Test Specification: NZeTA 3DS 2.0 Guidance
case.sourceBRD: BRD-SEC-2026-v2.3, Section 4.8: Multi-Currency Payment and 3DS Localization.

humanReviewFindings.description: AI hallucinated that credit cards with billing address in France require French translations. The BRD explicitly specifies English and Simplified Chinese only.
humanReviewFindings.actionTaken: Removed hallucinated test cases; added explicit Negative Test for unsupported locale fallback.

humanReviewFindings.description: AI omitted test for traveller changing browser language mid-session while OTP iframe is rendered.
humanReviewFindings.actionTaken: Created TC-3DS-019 to verify iframe session token persistence during mid-flight locale switch.

humanReviewFindings.description: AI used vague phrasing: 'Verify payment works properly'.
humanReviewFindings.actionTaken: Rewrote expected result to assert specific HTTP 200 payload, CAVV cryptogram, and Windcave Auth Code.

humanReview.reviewedBy: Mazher Hussain (Test Lead / QA Delivery Lead)
humanReview.rationale: Artefact sanitized of hallucinated requirements, enriched with critical negative edge cases, and mapped 100% to verifiable acceptance criteria.
